briefTitle: A Study of HER3-DXd in Subjects With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Participants aged ≥18 years (follow local regulatory requirements if the legal age of consent for study participation is >18 years old).

typedChecks.sourceText: Has Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) of 0 or 1 at screening.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologically or cytologically documented metastatic or locally advanced nonsquamous NSCLC not amenable to curative surgery or radiation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This trial evaluates multiple solid tumor cohorts including a nonsquamous NSCLC cohort, but specific stage lists are not provided.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has ≥1 measurable lesion on CT or MRI as per RECIST v1.1 by investigator assessment. Prostate cancer participants with bone only disease may be eligible.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Provides a pretreatment tumor tissue sample that meets 1 of the following collection requirements
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or ability to undergo a biopsy procedure is a subjective requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a history of (non-infectious) interstitial lung disease (ILD), that required corticosteroids, has current ILD/pneumonitis, or suspected ILD/pneumonitis cannot be ruled out by imaging at screening.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: ILD history involving corticosteroid requirement and imaging suspicion is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Documentation of absence of actionable driver mutation (ie, ALK rearrangement, BRAF V600E mutation, EGFR-activating mutations [exon 19 deletion or L858R mutation], EGFR exon 20 insertion mutation, HER2 mutation, KRAS G12C mutation, MET exon 14 skipping mutation, NTRK 1/2/3 gene fusion, RET rearrangement, or ROS1 rearrangement). New testing for these genomic alterations is not required for Screening.
